content.title: Of Justification by Faith
content.author: John Calvin · Institutes III.11, Ligonier excerpt
content.note: For forgiveness and Christ's righteousness received through faith alone, distinguished from the believer's renewal and works. Do not treat faith itself as a meritorious achievement.
